description: KP Astrology Category-Wise Rules — 200 core rules across 8 life domains

rules.rule_text: If 7th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 2, 7, or 11, marriage is promised. If it signifies 6, 8, or 12, there will be denial or delay.
Marriage timing is confirmed when the dasha/antardasha lord signifies houses 2, 7, and 11 simultaneously. The stronger the connection, the sooner the event.
Love marriage is indicated when the 5th cusp sub-lord also signifies the 7th house, or when Venus and the 5th lord are connected to the 7th house.
Arranged marriage is indicated when Saturn or Jupiter signifies the 7th house without 5th house connection. Family involvement is shown by 4th house connection.
Marriage delay occurs when the 7th cusp sub-lord signifies 6, 8, or 12 houses, or when Saturn aspects the 7th cusp sub-lord without positive house connections.

Spouse characteristics are determined by the 7th cusp sub-lord's sign, nakshatra, and the planets signifying the 7th house. Venus indicates beauty; Mercury indicates intelligence; Jupiter indicates wisdom.
Second marriage is possible when the 7th cusp sub-lord signifies 8th house (transformation) and the 9th house (second spouse in KP). Rahu involvement adds foreign or unconventional element.
Marital happiness is indicated when Venus and the 7th cusp sub-lord both signify positive houses (2, 7, 11). Affliction by Saturn or Mars to the 7th house causes friction.
Divorce or separation is indicated when the 7th cusp sub-lord strongly signifies the 12th house (loss of partnership) along with the 6th house (disputes). Rahu adds sudden separation.
Foreign or inter-cultural marriage is indicated when Rahu signifies the 7th house, or when the 7th cusp sub-lord is Rahu or placed in a foreign sign (Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, Aquarius).
For job change, check 10th cusp sub-lord. If it signifies houses 5 or 9, there will be change. If it signifies 6, 8, or 12, there are obstacles to change.
Career success is indicated when the 10th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 2, 6, and 10 simultaneously. The 11th house connection brings gains and recognition.
Government job is indicated when the Sun signifies the 10th house, or when the 10th cusp sub-lord is Sun or is in Sun's nakshatra. Leo or Aries connection strengthens this.
Business is indicated when the 7th house (partnerships) is stronger than the 6th house (service). If 6th cusp sub-lord signifies 10th, the person is suited for service/employment.
Promotion timing: when dasha/antardasha lords signify houses 2, 10, and 11. The 10th house brings status, 2nd brings income increase, 11th brings fulfillment of ambition.

Career field is determined by the strongest planet signifying the 10th house. Sun=government/authority, Moon=public/hospitality, Mars=engineering/military, Mercury=communication/IT, Jupiter=teaching/law, Venus=arts/luxury, Saturn=labor/mining, Rahu=technology/foreign, Ketu=research/spirituality.
Job loss or career setback occurs when the dasha lord signifies the 12th house (loss) and the 8th house (sudden change) without positive 10th house connection.
Foreign career or overseas job is indicated when the 10th cusp sub-lord signifies the 12th house (foreign lands) along with the 9th house (long journeys). Rahu strengthens this.
Self-employment and entrepreneurship: when the 10th cusp sub-lord signifies the 7th house (own business) and the 11th house (gains). Sun or Mars as significator adds leadership.
Complete career field change is indicated when the 10th cusp sub-lord changes its primary house signification during a major dasha transition. Rahu or Ketu involvement brings sudden shifts.
Wealth accumulation is indicated when the 2nd cusp sub-lord signifies houses 2, 11, and 8 (inheritance). The stronger the connection, the greater the wealth.
Financial improvement timing: when dasha/antardasha lords signify houses 2 (wealth) and 11 (gains). The 6th house connection brings income through service/effort.
Sudden wealth, windfall, or inheritance is indicated when the 8th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 2 and 11. Rahu involvement brings unexpected gains from foreign sources.
Debt clearance is indicated when the 6th cusp sub-lord (loans/debts) signifies the 11th house (gains/fulfillment). The dasha period must also activate houses 2 and 11.
Financial loss is indicated when the 2nd cusp sub-lord signifies the 12th house (expenses/losses) without 11th house support. Saturn's influence brings slow drain.
Investment gains through stocks, speculation, or real estate: when the 5th cusp sub-lord (speculation) signifies houses 2 and 11. Jupiter's involvement brings wisdom in investments.
Salary increase or bonus: when the dasha lord signifies houses 2 (income), 6 (service), and 11 (gains). The 10th house connection brings recognition that leads to raise.
General health is assessed through the 1st cusp sub-lord. If it signifies houses 1, 6, and 8, health challenges are indicated. Strong 1st house connection maintains vitality.
Health recovery timing: when dasha/antardasha lords signify houses 1 (self/vitality) and 11 (fulfillment/recovery). The 6th house connection shows the nature of illness.
Chronic health issues are indicated when Saturn signifies the 6th house and the 1st cusp sub-lord connects to the 8th house. Long-term treatment is shown by 12th house involvement.
Surgery or medical procedure is indicated when Mars signifies the 6th house and the dasha period activates houses 1, 6, and 8. The 12th house shows hospitalization.
Mental health challenges are indicated when Moon (mind) is afflicted and the 4th house (emotional peace) sub-lord connects to the 6th or 8th house. Saturn brings depression; Rahu brings anxiety.
Education success is indicated when the 4th cusp sub-lord (basic education) signifies houses 4, 9, and 11. Mercury and Jupiter as significators strengthen academic performance.
Higher education and advanced degrees: when the 9th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 4, 9, and 11. Jupiter's involvement brings wisdom; Mercury brings technical expertise.
Education abroad is indicated when the 9th cusp sub-lord signifies the 12th house (foreign lands) along with the 4th or 9th house. Rahu involvement adds foreign connection.
Education interruption or failure: when the 4th cusp sub-lord signifies the 12th house (loss) or 8th house (sudden change) without positive 9th or 11th house connection.
Children are promised when the 5th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 2, 5, and 11. Jupiter's involvement brings blessings of children. Affliction by Saturn or Ketu delays.
Childbirth timing: when dasha/antardasha lords signify houses 5 (children), 2 (family), and 11 (fulfillment). The 9th house connection brings fortune for the child.
Delay in having children: when the 5th cusp sub-lord signifies the 6th house (obstacles) or 8th house (transformation) without positive 5th or 11th house connection.
Property purchase is indicated when the 4th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 4, 11, and 12 (investment in property). Mars involvement brings land/real estate gains.
Property purchase timing: when dasha/antardasha lords signify houses 4 (home), 11 (gains), and 12 (investment/expenses for property). The 2nd house brings family home.
Property sale is indicated when the 4th cusp sub-lord signifies the 3rd house (change of residence) and 12th house (disposal of assets). Saturn brings delayed sale.
Foreign travel is indicated when the 12th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 3, 9, and 12. Rahu's involvement brings sudden or unconventional foreign trips. The 9th house shows long journeys.
Foreign settlement or long-term stay abroad: when the 12th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 4 (home) and 12 (foreign lands) simultaneously. Rahu or Ketu involvement strengthens this.
General luck and fortune are assessed through the 9th cusp sub-lord. If it signifies houses 1, 9, and 11, the person is generally fortunate. Jupiter as significator brings divine grace.
Obstacles and challenges arise when the dasha lord signifies houses 6 (enemies/debts), 8 (sudden setbacks), and 12 (losses) without positive house connections.
Spiritual growth and inclination: when Ketu signifies the 9th or 12th house, or when the 12th cusp sub-lord is Ketu or Jupiter. Saturn brings discipline in spiritual practice.
Marriage compatibility is assessed through the 7th cusp sub-lord and Venus. If both signify harmonious houses (1, 5, 7, 9, 11), compatibility is strong.
Early marriage (before 25) is indicated when Venus is strong and the 7th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 2, 7, 11 without Saturn's delay influence.
Late marriage (after 30) occurs when Saturn aspects or signifies the 7th house, or when the 7th cusp sub-lord is in Saturn's star.

Spouse's profession is indicated by planets signifying the 7th house. Sun=government, Moon=public sector, Mars=technical, Mercury=business/communication, Jupiter=teaching/law, Venus=arts, Saturn=labor, Rahu=IT/foreign.
Wealthy spouse is indicated when the 7th cusp sub-lord also signifies the 2nd house (wealth) and 11th house (gains). Jupiter or Venus strengthens prosperity.

Spouse's physical appearance: Venus=beautiful/fair, Mars=athletic/reddish, Saturn=dark/thin, Moon=fair/round face, Sun=wheatish/authoritative, Mercury=youthful, Jupiter=well-built, Rahu=unusual features.
Multiple marriages are indicated when the 7th cusp sub-lord signifies both 7th and 9th houses (second spouse), with Rahu or Venus involvement showing multiple relationships.
Secret or hidden relationship is indicated when the 12th house (secrets) is connected to the 5th house (romance) or 7th house (partnership). Rahu adds clandestine element.
Marriage after breakup or failed relationship: when the 7th cusp sub-lord signifies 6th house (separation from first) and then 11th house (fulfillment in second).
Spouse from workplace or professional circle: when the 7th cusp sub-lord signifies the 6th house (service/colleagues) or 10th house (profession).
Job stability is indicated when Saturn signifies the 6th or 10th house, providing long-term employment. Jupiter adds growth within the same organization.
Multiple income sources: when the 11th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 2, 6, and 10 simultaneously, indicating gains from various professional activities.
Creative career (arts, design, media): when Venus or Moon signifies the 10th house, or when the 5th house (creativity) is connected to the 10th house.
Technical/engineering career: when Mars or Mercury signifies the 10th house. Mars=mechanical/electrical, Mercury=IT/software, Saturn=civil/structural.
Medical/healthcare career: when the 6th house (healing) is connected to the 10th house, with Mars (surgery) or Jupiter (medicine) as significators.
Spouse's education level is indicated by the 9th house connection to the 7th house. Jupiter signifies higher education; Mercury indicates technical/business education.
Spouse's family background: 2nd house (family wealth) and 4th house (family status) connection to 7th house. Jupiter=respected family, Saturn=humble background.
Marriage location (home/destination): 4th house=home city, 12th house=foreign/distant place, 3rd house=nearby city.
Wedding ceremony timing: when dasha lords activate houses 2 (family gathering), 7 (marriage), and 11 (celebration).
Pre-marriage relationship duration: 5th house (romance) to 7th house (marriage) transition timing shows courtship period.
Age difference with spouse: Saturn=older spouse, Moon/Venus=younger spouse, Sun/Jupiter=similar age.
Obstacles in marriage: 6th house (disputes), 8th house (sudden breaks), 12th house (separation) afflicting 7th cusp sub-lord.
Inter-caste marriage: Rahu or Ketu signifying 7th house, or 7th cusp sub-lord in dual signs (Gemini, Sagittarius, Pisces).
Long-term marital happiness: Venus and 7th cusp sub-lord both in benefic houses (1,4,5,7,9,10,11) without malefic aspects.
Remarriage after divorce: 7th cusp sub-lord signifies 9th house (second spouse) with positive 2nd and 11th house connections.
Spouse's health: 8th house (longevity of spouse) and 6th house (illness of spouse) connections to 7th cusp sub-lord.
Legal marriage registration: 10th house (legal matters) connection to 7th house during dasha period.
Elopement or secret marriage: 12th house (secrecy) strongly connected to 5th (romance) and 7th (marriage) without 4th house (family).
Spouse's career change after marriage: 10th house from 7th (spouse's career) signified by dasha lord.
Marriage expenses and dowry: 12th house (expenses) and 2nd house (family wealth) activation during marriage dasha.
Spouse's siblings: 3rd house from 7th (9th house overall) shows spouse's younger siblings; 11th house from 7th (5th house) shows elder siblings.
Remedies for marriage delay: when Saturn delays 7th house, strengthen Venus and worship deities of 7th cusp sub-lord.
Love marriage happens earlier (Venus dasha); arranged marriage happens in Saturn/Jupiter dasha with family involvement.
Spouse from foreign country: Rahu in 7th, or 7th cusp sub-lord in 12th house with 9th house (foreign travel) connection.
Multiple marriage proposals: 7th cusp sub-lord signifies 11th house (multiple gains) with Venus in strong position.
Teaching/education career: Jupiter or Mercury signifying 10th house with 4th house (education) or 9th house (higher learning) connection.
Legal/law career: Jupiter signifying 10th house with 9th house (law/justice) connection. Saturn adds litigation practice.
Finance/banking career: Venus or Mercury signifying 10th house with 2nd house (wealth) and 11th house (gains) connection.
Sales/marketing career: Mercury (communication) and Venus (persuasion) signifying 10th house with 3rd house (communication).
Research/science career: Ketu or Saturn signifying 10th house with 8th house (deep investigation) connection.
Politics/public service: Sun or Jupiter signifying 10th house with 9th house (governance) and 11th house (mass gains).
Sports/athletics career: Mars signifying 10th house with 5th house (sports/competition) and 3rd house (physical effort).
Writing/journalism career: Mercury signifying 10th house with 3rd house (communication) and 9th house (publishing).
Hospitality/hotel career: Moon or Venus signifying 10th house with 4th house (comfort) and 12th house (service).
Real estate career: Mars or Saturn signifying 10th house with 4th house (property) and 11th house (gains).
Spiritual/religious career: Jupiter or Ketu signifying 10th house with 9th house (dharma) and 12th house (moksha).
Freelance/contract work: Mercury or Rahu signifying 10th house with 3rd house (self-effort) without 6th house (permanent service).
Agriculture/farming: Saturn or Moon signifying 10th house with 4th house (land) connection.
Aviation/pilot career: Rahu signifying 10th house with 9th house (long travel) and 12th house (foreign).
Social work/NGO: Moon or Jupiter signifying 10th house with 11th house (community) and 12th house (service).
Consulting/advisory: Jupiter or Mercury signifying 10th house with 9th house (wisdom) and 11th house (clients).
Startup/entrepreneurship: Sun or Rahu signifying 10th house with 7th house (business) and 11th house (innovation).
Career peak/pinnacle: Sun or Jupiter dasha with 10th cusp sub-lord signifying houses 2, 10, 11 simultaneously.
Career stagnation: Saturn dasha with 10th cusp sub-lord signifying 6th or 8th house without 11th house support.
Job transfer/relocation: 3rd house (change of place) and 10th house (career) signified by dasha lord with 12th house (new location).
Lottery/gambling gains: 5th house (speculation) and 8th house (sudden gains) signifying 2nd and 11th houses. Rahu adds luck.
Inheritance timing: 8th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 2 and 11 during dasha period. Jupiter brings ancestral wealth.
Business profit: 7th house (business) and 10th house (profession) both signifying 2nd and 11th houses.
Stock market success: 5th cusp sub-lord (speculation) signifies 2nd and 11th houses. Mercury adds trading skills.
Property/rental income: 4th house (property) signifying 11th house (gains). Saturn brings long-term rental income.
Foreign income/earnings: 12th house (foreign) signifying 2nd and 11th houses. Rahu strengthens foreign money.
Partnership business gains: 7th cusp sub-lord signifies 2nd, 10th, and 11th houses without 6th or 12th affliction.
Insurance claim/settlement: 8th house (insurance) signifying 11th house (gains) during favorable dasha.
Tax refund/recovery: 6th house (government dues) signifying 11th house (recovery) with 2nd house support.
Salary arrears/bonus: 2nd house (income) and 11th house (gains) activated by dasha lord with 6th house (service) connection.
Financial crisis: 2nd cusp sub-lord signifies 6th (debts), 8th (sudden loss), 12th (expenses) without 11th house support.
Bankruptcy/major loss: 2nd and 11th cusp sub-lords both signify 12th house with Saturn or Rahu affliction.
Loan approval: 6th cusp sub-lord (loans) signifies 2nd house (receiving money) and 11th house (fulfillment).
Debt trap/accumulation: 6th cusp sub-lord signifies 8th and 12th houses without 11th house (repayment capacity).
Gold/jewelry investment: Venus signifying 2nd house (wealth) and 11th house (gains) with 4th house (assets).
Cryptocurrency/modern trading: Rahu signifying 5th house (speculation) and 11th house (gains) with Mercury (technology).
Pension/retirement benefits: Saturn signifying 2nd and 11th houses in old age dasha periods.
Commission/incentive income: 3rd house (self-effort) and 10th house (profession) signifying 2nd and 11th houses.
Royalty/passive income: 5th house (creativity) or 9th house (publishing) signifying 2nd and 11th houses.
Financial independence: 2nd and 11th cusp sub-lords both strong, signifying each other without 6th, 8th, 12th affliction.
Charity/donations: 12th house (giving away) activated during Jupiter or Venus dasha with 9th house (dharma).
Financial fraud/cheating: Rahu or Ketu afflicting 2nd house with 6th (disputes) or 8th (sudden loss) connection.
Wealth preservation: Saturn signifying 2nd and 11th houses, providing stability and long-term accumulation.
Digestive/stomach issues: 6th cusp sub-lord in earthy signs (Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn) with Mars or Saturn affliction.
Respiratory/lung issues: 6th cusp sub-lord in airy signs (Gemini, Libra, Aquarius) with Mercury or Saturn affliction.
Cardiac/heart issues: Sun or Mars afflicting 4th house (heart) or 6th house with Leo sign involvement.
Kidney/urinary issues: Venus afflicted in 6th house or 6th cusp sub-lord in Libra/Scorpio with Saturn.
Diabetes/blood sugar: Jupiter afflicted in 6th house or 6th cusp sub-lord with Venus in watery signs.
Blood pressure issues: Mars or Sun afflicting 6th house with 1st house (vitality) connection.
Joint/bone pain: Saturn signifying 6th house with 1st house (body) affliction in earthy signs.
Skin diseases: Mars, Saturn, or Rahu afflicting 6th house in fiery signs (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius).
Eye/vision problems: Sun or Moon afflicted in 6th house or 2nd house (eyes) with Saturn/Rahu.
Dental/teeth problems: Saturn afflicting 2nd house (mouth/teeth) or 6th house in Capricorn/Aquarius.
Migraine/headaches: Mars or Rahu afflicting 1st house (head) or 6th house in Aries.
Anxiety/panic disorders: Rahu afflicting Moon (mind) or 4th house with 6th or 8th house connection.
Insomnia/sleep disorders: Saturn or Rahu afflicting Moon or 4th house (rest) with 6th house connection.
Accident proneness: Mars signifying 6th and 8th houses with 1st house (body) affliction during dasha.
Allergies/immune issues: Mercury or Moon afflicted in 6th house with Rahu in airy or watery signs.
Thyroid issues: Venus or Mercury afflicted in 6th house in Taurus (throat) with Saturn.
Liver problems: Jupiter afflicted in 6th house or 5th house (liver) with Mars or Saturn in fiery signs.
Gynecological issues (women): Moon or Venus afflicted in 6th or 8th house in watery signs.
Prostate issues (men): Mars or Saturn afflicting 6th or 8th house in Scorpio with age factor.
Recovery speed from illness: 1st and 11th house strength; Jupiter or Venus dasha brings faster healing.
Scholarship/financial aid for education: 4th or 9th cusp sub-lord signifies 2nd and 11th houses with Jupiter.
Competitive exam success: Mercury strong, 4th cusp sub-lord signifies 4th, 9th, 11th houses during exam dasha.
Engineering degree: Mars or Mercury signifying 4th and 9th houses with technical sign (Gemini, Virgo, Aquarius).
Medical degree: Mars or Jupiter signifying 4th and 9th houses with 6th house (healing) connection.
MBA/business degree: Mercury or Jupiter signifying 9th house with 7th house (business) and 10th house (career).
PhD/research degree: Ketu or Saturn signifying 9th house with 8th house (deep study) and 12th house (isolation).
Arts/humanities degree: Venus or Moon signifying 4th and 9th houses with 5th house (creativity).
Law degree: Jupiter signifying 9th house (law) with 10th house (profession) and 6th house (litigation).
Distance/online education: Rahu or Mercury signifying 4th or 9th house with 12th house (remote) connection.
Education loan: 6th cusp sub-lord (loans) signifies 4th or 9th house (education) with 2nd house (money).
Education dropout: 4th or 9th cusp sub-lord signifies 12th house (loss) or 8th house (break) without 11th house.
Exam failure: Mercury weak, 4th cusp sub-lord signifies 6th (obstacles) or 8th (sudden setback) during exam.
Top rank/excellence: Mercury and Jupiter both strong, 4th and 9th cusp sub-lords signify 1st, 9th, 11th houses.
Vocational/skill training: 3rd house (skills) and 10th house (profession) signified by 4th cusp sub-lord.
Language learning: Mercury signifying 4th house with 3rd house (communication) and 9th house (foreign language).
Gap year/education break: 4th cusp sub-lord signifies 3rd house (change) or 12th house (pause) during dasha.
First child gender: Male if Mars/Sun/Jupiter signifies 5th house; Female if Moon/Venus signifies 5th house.
Twins/multiple births: 5th cusp sub-lord in dual signs (Gemini, Sagittarius, Pisces) with Mercury or Jupiter.
Child's health: 5th cusp sub-lord should not signify 6th or 8th house; Jupiter protection brings healthy child.
Adoption of child: 5th cusp sub-lord signifies 12th house (not own) with 9th house (legal) and 11th house (fulfillment).
IVF/medical assistance: 5th cusp sub-lord signifies 6th house (medical) and 11th house (success) with Mars (surgery).
Miscarriage risk: 5th cusp sub-lord signifies 12th house (loss) or 8th house (sudden end) with Mars or Ketu affliction.
Child's education success: 5th house (children) and 9th house (education) both strong with Jupiter or Mercury.
Child's career prospects: 5th house (children) and 10th house (career) connection shows child's professional success.
Child's marriage: 5th house (children) and 7th house (marriage) connection during appropriate dasha period.
Son birth: Sun, Mars, or Jupiter strongly signifying 5th house in masculine signs (Aries, Gemini, Leo, Libra, Sagittarius, Aquarius).
Daughter birth: Moon or Venus strongly signifying 5th house in feminine signs (Taurus, Cancer, Virgo, Scorpio, Capricorn, Pisces).
Child settling abroad: 5th house (children) and 12th house (foreign) connection with 9th house (long travel).
Ancestral property inheritance: 4th house (property) and 8th house (inheritance) signified by dasha lord.
Property dispute: 4th cusp sub-lord signifies 6th house (disputes) or 8th house (conflict) with Mars or Saturn.
Property sale profit: 4th cusp sub-lord signifies 3rd house (sale) and 11th house (gains) during favorable dasha.
Property loss/forced sale: 4th cusp sub-lord signifies 12th house (loss) or 8th house (sudden) with 6th house (debts).
Land/plot purchase: Mars signifying 4th house with 11th house (gains) and 12th house (investment).
Apartment/flat purchase: Venus or Moon signifying 4th house with 11th and 12th houses in urban signs.
Villa/independent house: Sun or Jupiter signifying 4th house with 2nd house (wealth) and 11th house (luxury).
Property construction: Mars signifying 4th house with 10th house (building) and 12th house (expenses).
Property renovation: 4th cusp sub-lord signifies 3rd house (change) and 12th house (expenses) with Mars.
Renting property (as tenant): 4th cusp sub-lord signifies 12th house (expenses) without 11th house (ownership).
Property loan/mortgage: 6th cusp sub-lord (loans) signifies 4th house (property) and 11th house (approval).
Property legal documentation: 10th house (legal) signifying 4th house (property) during registration dasha.
Property location: 4th cusp sub-lord in watery signs=near water, earthy=land, fiery=hills, airy=open area.
Property direction: 4th cusp sub-lord planet's natural direction (Sun=East, Moon=NW, Mars=South, etc.).
Commercial property: 4th house (property) and 10th house (business) signified with 7th house (trade).
Agricultural land: 4th house (land) and Saturn (agriculture) with earthy signs (Taurus, Virgo, Capricorn).
Property in foreign country: 4th house (property) and 12th house (foreign) signified by Rahu or 9th house.
Court case victory: 6th cusp sub-lord signifies 11th house (victory over enemies) with Jupiter or Sun strength.
Court case defeat: 6th cusp sub-lord signifies 12th house (loss) or 8th house (sudden adverse) with Saturn.
Vehicle purchase: 4th cusp sub-lord (vehicles) signifies 11th house (gains) and 12th house (expenses) with Venus or Mars.
Vehicle accident: Mars afflicting 4th house (vehicles) or 3rd house (short travel) with 6th or 8th house.
Pet animals: 6th house (small animals) signified positively with Venus or Moon; avoid if 6th cusp sub-lord in 8th/12th.
Theft/burglary: 4th house (home) or 2nd house (wealth) afflicted by Rahu or Saturn in 6th, 8th, or 12th house.
Fame/public recognition: 10th cusp sub-lord signifies 1st, 5th, 10th, 11th houses with Sun or Jupiter strength.
Scandal/defamation: 10th house (reputation) afflicted by Rahu or Saturn signifying 6th, 8th, or 12th house.
City relocation: 3rd house (change of place) and 4th house (home) signified by dasha lord with 12th house (leaving).
Pilgrimage/spiritual travel: 9th house (pilgrimage) and 12th house (travel) signified by Jupiter or Ketu.
Competition/contest success: 5th house (competition) and 11th house (victory) signified with Mars or Sun strength.
Lottery/lucky win: 5th house (speculation) and 8th house (sudden) signifying 2nd and 11th houses with Rahu or Jupiter.
